fields.description: Issue dated September 1, 1928 (Vol. 5, No. 31) featuring editorials and local commentary on whether Miami will have horse racing in the coming winter season (including discussion of Hialeah and the Miami Jockey Club), the city’s approach to amusements and gambling enforcement, and the economic emphasis on tourism versus industry. Additional pieces address Chamber of Commerce staffing and finances, police examinations and law enforcement practices, one-way versus two-way street traffic systems, funding plans for new University of Miami buildings via Coral Gables actions and related bequests, concerns about harbor development, and letters/opinion on radio broadcasts and banking practices. Includes society columns and extensive local advertising.
coverage: Greater Miami (Miami-Dade County), Florida, United States
